  line: String
record State:
  owner: String

  let written(_) = write {shade: 3n, glows: insert {n: Relations.count(state.glows), who: context.principal, line: input.line}}
  Relations.count(state.glows) + 1n
form dim:
  note: text 0..80
def dim(state: State, input: {note: String}, context: Abi.Context) -> Activity<Nat>:
  let written(_) = write {shade: state.shade - 1n}
  state.shade - 1n

  Document.text("an ember at shade {natText(state.shade)}, {natText(Relations.count(state.glows))} warmths held\n")
